title: Create button disabled while Email is empty
summary: On a sign-up form with an empty Email field, the "Create account" button is disabled.
what_differs: The broken page leaves the "Create account" button enabled while the Email field is empty, and it looks the same.

wordings.text: Verify the "Create account" button is disabled.
Verify that the "Create account" button has the disabled state and cannot be clicked while the Email field is empty.
